flora: Isolated tufts of dry desert grass
environment_details.style_notes: High-fidelity 3D; ultra-smooth, mirror-finish elytra (wing cases); wide, shovel-shaped front tibia (legs) for digging; no visible external 'fuzz' to prevent sand friction.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle shot of the beetle mid-climb on a steep red sand dune. As it moves, it leaves a distinctive 'braided' track in the fine sand behind it. The sun is reflecting off its back in a sharp starburst. In the far distance, a massive sauropod footprint is visible in the valley floor.
visual_logic.ground: Fine-grained red sand with perfect ripple physics; some grains are actively 'sliding' down the dune around the beetle's legs.
visual_logic.lighting: High-noon desert sun, creating high-specular highlights on the beetle's back and deep, sharp shadows in the sand ripples.
